en.tagline: Stops generic coding-assistant UI on new pages
en.summary: Hallmark is a design skill for new websites and pages built by a coding assistant. It applies a fixed set of rules against common default patterns, deals a theme so that separate builds do not look alike, and limits each screen to one idea. It runs when the user asks to build something new or names Hallmark.
problem: A coding assistant tends to produce the same default page: the same fonts, colours, gradients and card layouts, plus invented numbers. Pages made this way look generated.
Hallmark sets a floor of rules that every output must pass, then picks a direction so that consecutive builds differ. The page uses only the user's real material and keeps to one idea per screen.
fit: Building a new website or landing page from a prompt
A new page that should not look generic
A request that names a theme or asks for a custom look
unfit: Changing an existing design when the user does not name Hallmark
Work that needs only plain edits in the project's own design system
steps: Before asking anything, it reads the project, then asks one round of questions on material, audience, use and tone, unless the prompt already answers them.
It designs the page shape and sets the one idea each screen carries.
It deals a theme from the theme set, or uses a custom direction when the user asks for one.
It builds the hero first, then the rest of the page, and writes the decisions into a stamp at the top of the CSS.
It runs sloplint with render checks, fixes every FAIL and REFLEX finding, and records any waiver with a reason.
It runs a finish review and ends by asking for the material that would most improve the page.

zh.tagline: 让新页面看起来是设计过的，而非批量生成的
zh.summary: Hallmark 是一个设计技能，用于编码助手为用户构建的新网站和新页面。它用一组固定规则限制常见的默认写法，为每次构建选定一个主题，使连续的构建不会趋同，并让每个屏幕只表达一个主题。当用户要求构建新内容或点名 Hallmark 时运行。
problem: 编码助手常生成同一种默认页面：相同的字体、颜色、渐变和卡片布局，还会编造数字。这样做出的页面一眼就像生成的。
Hallmark 先设定每个输出都必须通过的底线规则，再确定风格方向，让连续的构建彼此不同。页面只使用用户提供的真实素材，每屏只讲一件事。
fit: 根据提示词新建网站或落地页
新页面不希望显得千篇一律
用户指定了主题或要求自定义风格
unfit: 用户没有点名 Hallmark，却要修改已有设计
只需在项目自有设计系统中做普通修改的工作
steps: 开始前先读取项目，然后只提出一轮问题，涉及素材、受众、用途和语气，提示词已回答的除外。
设计页面结构，并确定每个屏幕承载的那一个主题。
从主题集中选定一个主题，或在用户要求时采用自定义方向。
先构建首屏，再构建页面其余部分，并把所做的决定写进 CSS 顶部的标记。
运行 sloplint 渲染检查，修正所有 FAIL 和 REFLEX 项，对豁免项记录理由。
进行收尾审阅，最后询问哪些素材最能改善页面。
